title: Graph Delta Record
description: Per-scope structural diff between committed and freshly built skill graph, computed at /sync time. This is a machine-written artifact recording changes to the Domain Execution Graph (ADR-0084). Not an evidence model; persisted to docs/graph-deltas/<YYYY>/<date>-<commit>-<scope>.json for consumption by evidence-backport-scan.ts (M2, M4, M6b maturity bar tests) and potential future SkillHone Evolution Loop use.

schema_version.description: Schema version; bumped on breaking changes to totals, type breakdown, or ID inclusion policy (ADR-0084 §8 open question 10)

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 instant when delta was computed

commit.description: Short commit hash (8 hex digits) that triggered this delta

pr.description: Pull request number, if delta was computed during /sync inside a PR context (optional)

scope.description: Variant scope or 'common' (per-scope records per ADR-0084 §5.4)

by_node_type.description: Breakdown of node additions/removals by node type (skill, agent, procedure, stage, etc.)

by_edge_type.description: Breakdown of edge additions/removals by edge type (step_uses_skill, accountable_for, etc.)

nodes_added.description: Explicit node IDs when total changed elements ≤ 50 (design §5.4)

edges_added.description: Edge tuples as 'from|to|type' when ≤ 50 total changed (design §5.4)

truncated.description: True if total changed elements > 50 and ID arrays are omitted (design §5.4)
